class.name: VECSSnapshotReplication
class.brief_description:
Default server-authoritative replication: dirty-checked deltas + periodic full-state reconciliation.
默认的服务器权威复制：脏检查增量 + 定期全量对账。
class.description:
[b]VECSSnapshotReplication[/b] is the default [VECSSyncStrategy]. The server tracks which networked components are dirty, sends spawns/deltas/despawns, and periodically broadcasts a full state so clients can reconcile and remove ghosts. Entities with at least one networked component (the default) replicate automatically.
[b]VECSSnapshotReplication[/b] 是默认的 [VECSSyncStrategy]。服务器跟踪哪些联网组件是脏的，发送生成/增量/反生成，并定期广播全量状态供客户端对账、清除幽灵实体。至少含一个联网组件（默认）的实体自动复制。

members.member:
Seconds between periodic full-state broadcasts. Lower it for faster convergence at the cost of bandwidth.
两次定期全量广播之间的秒数。调低可加快收敛，代价是带宽。
